messages:
noah: quick planning thread 1) EU runtime + pinned-model swap on 2026-04-07 01:00 UTC (window ~30m). 2) single-region first, then evaluate before global. Need short statuspage copy, customer email (plain + technical), and in-app banner. @mika-support can you draft?
rachel: FYI auto-rollback on latency breach: revert pin to model:stable-202603 and route 10% traffic to hosted-fallback. thresholds: p95 >350ms for 10m or error-rate >1.5x baseline.
mika-support: will draft both emails and a 1-liner for statuspage. who needs localized copies?
ivan-ops: add these pre-checks: snapshot configs T-2h, cache pre-warm T-45m, canary smoke T-20m. also revoke admin dev-keys before T-1h. I'll post checklist to MNT-4122.
deploy-bot: MNT-4122 created. scheduled start 1805562000 end 1805563800. canaries configured: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. auto-hold enabled on health failures. will emit events to /eng-oncall.
status-bot: saved draft to /ops/status-drafts/MNT-4122. public publish scheduled T-30m for review.
mika-support: statuspage snippet (suggested): "Planned maintenance: brief runtime and pinned-model update in EU (Apr 7 01:00 UTC). You may see short latency spikes while caches warm. No data changes expected. Contact support@redwood.ai for SLA coordination."
rachel: SMS/webhook for enterprise please. Keep SMS under 140 chars: "Redwood: brief maintenance in your region starting soon. Check status.redwood.ai or your inbox for details."
mika-support: email drafts posted to /ops/status-drafts/MNT-4122 (eng-only). will add FR/DE drafts on request.
ivan-ops: kicking off prechecks now; will update MNT-4122 when green.
noah: great. action items: mika publish T-30m, ivan run prechecks, deploy-bot monitor holds, rachel enable enterprise SMS. keep MNT-4122 for live logs. keep replies short here.
